g.title: SWCTCF
g.text: SWC-TCF — Smart Waste Collection Two-Commodity Flow exact model

Compact arc-based MILP: binary arcs x_ij, visit indicators g_i, fleet size k, and two continuous commodities per arc (f = waste on board, h = residual capacity) whose sum equals Q·x_ij. Flow balance enforces capacity and eliminates subtours without exponential cut families. Solved by Gurobi / SCIP / HiGHS / CPLEX through OR-Tools, Pyomo or native gurobipy.

g.title: cluster_model
g.text: — _run_gurobi_optimizer(bins, dist, env, values, binsids, mandatory, K, time_limit, seed, duals)

g.title: a_params
g.text: Load Q (capacity, % points), R (€ per % fill), C (€ / km)
sub-problem (all bins if vrpp) · SWCTCFParams: framework 'ortools',
engine 'gurobi', time_limit 60 s, seed · config: Omega, delta, psi

g.title: a_arrays
g.text: amounts[i−1] = fill % of local bin i · binsids = 1..n

g.title: a_run
g.text: number_vehicles, time_limit, framework, optimizer, seed, dual_values)

g.title: a_clean
g.text: strip depot zeros from raw route → [[bins…]]
map local ids → global tour · km on full matrix

g.title: d_ort
g.text: same TCF model built with BoolVar / NumVar / IntVar

g.title: d_pyomo
g.text: Pyomo ConcreteModel with gurobi | scip | appsi_highs

g.title: m_sets
g.text: nodes N = {0 (depot), 1..n} · S_i = fill % of node i (S₀ = 0)
feasible arcs A = {(i, j): i ≠ j, d_ij ≤ 6 000 km}

g.title: m_vars
g.text: x_ij ∈ {0,1} arc used · g_i ∈ {0,1} node visited
f_ij ≥ 0 waste flowing on arc · h_ij ≥ 0 empty capacity flowing on arc
k ∈ ℤ₊ number of vehicles used

g.title: m_c1
g.text: (1) Arc capacity coupling: f_ij + h_ij = Q · x_ij ∀(i,j) ∈ A

g.title: m_c2
g.text: (2) Waste balance at node i ≠ 0: Σ_j f_ij − Σ_j f_ji = S_i · g_i
(3) Empty-capacity balance: Σ_j h_ji − Σ_j h_ij = S_i · g_i

g.title: m_c3
g.text: (4) Depot: Σ_i f_i0 = Σ_i S_i·g_i (all waste returns)
Σ_j h_0j = Q · k (trucks leave empty)

g.title: m_c4
g.text: (5) Fleet: k ≤ K (K = n if 0) · Σ_j x_0j = k · Σ_j x_j0 = k

g.title: m_c5
g.text: (6) Mandatory coverage: Σ_{i critical} g_i ≥ #critical − n·delta
g_i = 1 if critical_i or S_i ≥ psi · 100 (near-full bins forced)

g.title: m_c6
g.text: (7) Degree: Σ_i x_ij = g_j and Σ_k x_jk = g_j ∀ j ≠ 0
(subtour elimination and capacity are implied by the two-commodity flows)

g.title: m_obj_std
g.text: OBJECTIVE (standard): max R·Σ S_i·g_i − ½·C·Σ d_ij·x_ij − Omega·k

g.title: m_obj_dual
g.text: OBJECTIVE (reduced cost): max Σ (R·S_i − π_i)·g_i − ½·C·Σ d_ij·x_ij − π₀·k

g.title: m_params
g.text: Gurobi params (no shared env): MIPFocus 1, Heuristics 0.5, Cuts 3,

g.title: e_walk
g.text: walk from depot following unused active arcs
until back at 0 → one route; repeat while a route was found

g.title: e_out
g.text: collected = concatenated node ids of all routes (local → binsids)
profit = ObjVal · cost = Σ x_ij · d_ij
